name: wasifyai-video-builder-component
description: The packages the Video Builder component installs (ADR-0077). Exact versions; the lock holds integrity hashes. The two font packages are SIL OFL-1.1 (Inter, Source Serif 4): the templates' shipped fonts (ADR-0079, MG1). The two installer packages carry FFmpeg 4.4 and ffprobe 4.4.1 for the platform (HyperFrames finds them by itself; their install scripts do not run, the app sets the executable bit).
